Wails generates wailsjs/go/main/App.js with a // @ts-check header, and its arg1-style wrappers plus window['go'] lookups are untyped by design: with implicit-any checking on, that one generated file reports a hundred TS7006/TS7015 errors. Generated files must not be edited, so the switch is turned off here instead. checkJs stays false so src/main.js, which imports CSS modules, is not type-checked either.
